text:
alexa: Heads-up — sudden tail latency bump in eu-prod-gyro around 08:23 UTC. p50 ~40ms, p95 ~140ms, p99 jumped from ~120ms to ~1.3s. Throughput steady, errors ~0. Suspect packing/admission + noisy tenant.

ops-bot: deploy bot: scheduler-service v2.3.1 deployed to eu-prod-gyro at 08:21:12 UTC by @jordan (sha: ab12f3).

mike: I spun up a quick loadgen against staging with short-request workload (8-20 tokens). Reproduced p99 spikes. Microbatch size distribution skewed heavily to size=1..3. Admission saw bursty arrivals and packed batches frequently ended up tiny.

sarah: profiler snapshot (sampled CPU + kernel events) shows kernel_selector wait spikes and repeated kernel_init calls. KV cache eviction rate up 4x during spike window. Paste of relevant bits:
```
[PROFILE] kernel_pick_time  ->  120ms (spike)
[PROFILE] kernel_init     ->  140ms (occasional)
[STATS] kvcache.evictions  202 -> 820 / 30s
[METRIC] microbatch.size.p50 1, p90 3, p99 6
```

jordan: FYI I merged a small packing tweak yesterday that lowered packing_hold_ms from 5ms to 2ms to reduce latency for small requests. config diff:
```diff
- packing_hold_ms: 5
+ packing_hold_ms: 2
```

lee: That tweak makes sense for small stable workloads but with a noisy tenant flood it forces more frequent pack attempts and creates many tiny microbatches. Those increase kernel setup overhead and make KV cache churn worse. Suggest temporary mitigation: route the noisy tenant (search-lite) to a separate pool and bump packing_hold_ms back to 5ms on eu-prod-gyro.

alexa: Proposed runbook: 1) route search-lite to isolated pool (lee) 2) rollback packing_hold_ms to 5ms (jordan) 3) enforce kernel preference fallback to legacy_low_mem for tiny batches (temp flag) 4) add microbatch size percentiles and kvcache.evictions alert (sarah) 5) verify with staging loadgen (mike). Assign owners: mike, sarah, jordan, lee.

mike: starting canary now — will route 5% of traffic to isolated pool and flip kernel-fallback flag. Posting canary logs in 2m.

sarah: PR opened for metrics/alerts: https://git.redwood/s/repo/pull/2647 — adds microbatch.size.{p50,p90,p99} and kvcache.evictions/s alerts (thresholds p99>30 -> page).

jordan: rollback config change applied to eu-prod-gyro at 08:28:03 UTC (packing_hold_ms=5). Monitoring.

ops-bot: routing update: route search-lite -> eu-prod-lowutil applied at 08:29:10 UTC by @lee.

mike: Canary looks promising. p99 dropped from ~1.2s -> ~160ms for canaried traffic, overall cluster p99 trending down. Microbatch p99 also down to ~7.

lee: Leaving isolation in place until we confirm no regressions. Will coordinate with infra to size lowutil pool if persistent.

sarah: Collected flamegraph + KV metrics. Will attach to ticket with root-cause notes. Early hypothesis: packing_hold_ms reduction exposed kernel-init overhead and caused frequent tiny microbatches which in turn increased KV cache thrash and evicted hot KV entries for longer sessions, amplifying tail latency for certain requests.

alexa: Good triage. Next steps: postmortem if not fully resolved in 6 hours, adjust packing autoscaling knob to be workload-aware, and add an automatic noisy-tenant detector that can route/limit by microbatch footprint. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
